A menu of uncertainty-aware dependence indices

Source: R/index.R
pollin_index.Rd

Returns several dependence indices for an open-versus-exclusion contrast, each with an interval where one is available: the Relative Interaction Index (bootstrap interval), the log response ratio (closed-form interval, the meta-analytic workhorse), and the proportional dependence ratio. Provided so an analysis can report a defensible, interval-bearing index instead of a bare ratio.

Usage

pollin_index(
  open,
  cage,
  n_boot = 2000L,
  conf = 0.95,
  seed = NULL,
  response = NULL,
  unit = NULL
)

Arguments

open

Numeric vector of the open-arm (pollinator-accessible) values, or a pollin_design() with an "excluded" and an "open" arm.

cage

Numeric vector of the exclusion-arm values. Leave it empty when open is a design.

n_boot

Number of bootstrap resamples.

conf

Confidence level.

seed

Optional integer seed for reproducibility.

response

With a design, the response column to use. It may be left NULL when the data declare one response.

unit

With a design, the unit column the arm means are taken over, one of the design's unit nesting. NULL (the default) uses the outermost unit; an inner unit is taken within its outer units.

Value

A data frame of indices with estimates and intervals where available.

Details

Given a pollin_design(), the indices are computed from unit-level arm means, as described in pollin_rii().

Examples

set.seed(1)
pollin_index(rpois(50, 9), rpois(50, 6), n_boot = 500, seed = 1)
#>              index  estimate  conf.low conf.high
#> 1              RII 0.2125984 0.1599841 0.2691237
#> 2             lnRR 0.4317824 0.3064261 0.5571387
#> 3 dependence_ratio 0.3506494        NA        NA
#>                                                              note
#> 1                                                    bootstrap CI
#> 2                                                  closed-form CI
#> 3 point; do not regress on open yield (see pollin_guard_spurious)

# From a design with two responses: name the one to use
df <- data.frame(
  pods = rpois(48, 30),
  seed_wt = rgamma(48, 20, 5),
  trt = rep(c("Cage", "Open"), 24),
  Site = rep(letters[1:4], each = 12)
)
pd <- pollin_data(df, c("pods", "seed_wt"), "trt", unit = "Site")
ds <- pollin_design(pd, c(excluded = "Cage", open = "Open"), "multi_site")
pollin_index(ds, response = "pods", n_boot = 200, seed = 1)
#>              index    estimate    conf.low  conf.high
#> 1              RII -0.02251271 -0.08115501 0.02117663
#> 2             lnRR -0.04503303 -0.16107187 0.07100581
#> 3 dependence_ratio -0.04606241          NA         NA
#>                                                              note
#> 1                                                    bootstrap CI
#> 2                                                  closed-form CI
#> 3 point; do not regress on open yield (see pollin_guard_spurious)
